title: One non-terminal checkpoint with six independently visible workflow tensions

source.task_anchor: 為既有本機檔案索引器探索增量更新 pilot，維持目前公開 CLI。這個 checkpoint 先決定最小可驗證路徑與責任邊界，再決定是否擴充。
source.event_context: 首次大變更：git diff --stat 為 +486/-74。新增 Pipeline → Coordinator → BackendAdapter 與三個尚未使用的 backend stub；本週 pilot 只會使用 local-json。scanner.py、watcher.py、reindex.py 各有一份大小寫、filter、extension 規則。seen version 暫存在 process cache；local-json 先更新 search index，再寫 version state，watcher timeout 後會 retry。單元測試使用 fake backend，只跑 sequential create → update。benchmark 在同一 process 對 1,000 個已載入 path 重複 20 次並取最佳值，尚無 cold CLI baseline。
source.assistant_context: 核心擴充點已經鋪好；下一步準備先實作 cloud backend、調整 cache，再做第一次 local-json 端到端試跑。

jeff.label: system boundary and downstream cost
jeff.expected_attention: Question whether choosing a multi-backend boundary before the local pilot is causing downstream coordination and duplicated policy.

beck.label: small step and feedback
beck.expected_attention: Question adding cloud support and cache tuning before the first local end-to-end feedback loop.

fowler.label: knowledge boundary and change cost
fowler.expected_attention: Notice normalization/filter/extension knowledge duplicated across scanner, watcher, and reindex.

linus.label: direct path and necessary complexity
linus.expected_attention: Question what irreplaceable behavior Pipeline, Coordinator, Adapter, and unused stubs add to the local-only pilot.

lamport.label: state, ordering, and invariant
lamport.expected_attention: Question index-before-state plus timeout retry across interruption or reordered delivery.

carmack.label: representative execution and measurement
carmack.expected_attention: Question optimizing cache from a warm best-of loop before measuring the real cold CLI path.
